heading: Committee Advances Grant Request for Land Near Patrick Marsh
summary: The Committee of the Whole referred a Dane County conservation grant application to the Common Council. The proposal would add 107 acres near Patrick Marsh, with staff estimating a city contribution of about $855,000 from park acquisition funds. Officials said the purchase depended on the county grant and further city action.

heading: Council Authorizes Patrick Marsh Grant Application
summary: The Common Council voted 8–0 to approve an application for county conservation funding. The request would help Sun Prairie acquire land near Patrick Marsh. The council was told the city's share would come from park acquisition fees.
